_comment: Exercises trap.c animate_statue() through detect.c dosearch0() while the hero hallucinates. A wizard-mode wish places a statue trap beside a dwarven Caveman, who quaffs hallucination and searches until the trap fires away from his square. The 'suddenly seems more animated' message names a monster from do_name.c rndmonnam(), which draws on the display RNG, before delobj() deletes the statue.
